title: CMS MSSP workbook export contract, v1
description: Canonical, machine-readable API for the BNMRK / AEXPU / QEXPU / STLMT sectioned-workbook exports. Every data sheet in these four ACO benchmark and settlement workbooks is unpivoted into one long/tidy, cell-grain relation: one row per (sheet row x sheet column) cell, carrying the section/row/column hierarchy plus path-derived delivery metadata. This contract publishes the exact set of thirty-three relations, the cell-grain schemas they conform to, and the optional-sheet behavior, so consumers can check benchmark outputs independently. Real agreement rows remain client-owned; this contract exposes shape and versioning only.

cell_grain.description: The long/tidy schema every BNMRK/AEXPU/QEXPU relation conforms to; STLMT relations use stlmt_cell_grain, which extends it. The first eight columns are the sheet grammar (section/row/column hierarchy and the verbatim cell value); the remaining ten are path-derived delivery metadata appended to every row. Column names are the exported (lowercase, cross-warehouse-normalised) identifiers. All cell values are emitted VARCHAR verbatim; typing and casting happen downstream in dbt.

columns.name: row_num
columns.description: 1-based position of the source row as the sheet reader returned it.

columns.name: group_label
columns.description: Nearest unbracketed section header above the row (the merged primary group).

columns.name: section_code
columns.description: Bracketed section code, e.g. 'A1' from '[A1] Person Years'; NULL for an unbracketed section.

columns.name: section_label
columns.description: Label of the section the row belongs to.

columns.name: row_label
columns.description: Normalised label from column A of the data row.

columns.name: column_group_label
columns.description: Merged primary header above a two-level column header; NULL for single-level headers and always NULL on key/value (Parameters) sheets.

columns.name: column_label
columns.description: Header label of the value column this cell came from.

columns.name: value_text
columns.description: The cell value, VARCHAR verbatim ('-' stays '-').

columns.name: file_path
columns.description: Slash-normalised source workbook path; the incremental-dedup key.

columns.name: directory_name
columns.description: Directory portion of file_path.

columns.name: file_name
columns.description: Base filename of the source workbook.

columns.name: file_date
columns.description: Delivery date derived from the path/filename; NULL when the stamp is a placeholder or otherwise unparseable.

columns.name: aco_id
columns.description: ACO identifier the run is scoped to.

columns.name: performance_year
columns.description: Four-digit performance year from the directory layout; NULL when absent.

columns.name: benchmark_year
columns.description: Benchmark year from the AEXPU 'Y<year>' filename token; always NULL for BNMRK, QEXPU and STLMT.

columns.name: submission_id
columns.description: Delivery identity. Benchmark and quarterly files: the file's 'D<YYMMDD>.T<NNNNNNN>' stamp. Files in a final settlement (STLMT) bundle, and the STLMT workbook wherever it is filed: 'STLMT.' plus the bundle directory's stamp (the file's stamp when the directory has none, or when a STLMT workbook sits outside a STLMT bundle), so a settlement never joins a benchmark delivery that shares its stamp. NULL when absent.

columns.name: period
columns.description: Family-specific period token: the submission id (BNMRK), 'Y<year>' (AEXPU), the literal quarter such as '2026Q1' (QEXPU), or 'Y<performance_year>' (STLMT).

columns.name: is_embargoed
columns.description: Settlement (STLMT) files only: TRUE for the embargoed delivery, FALSE for the unembargoed one. Taken from the delivery's T stamp (T0000000 embargoed, T1111111 unembargoed), else from the Embargoed/Unembargoed FinRec notice file in the bundle (the one value not derived from the workbook's own path: it comes from a listing of the bundle directory, read when the workbook is first loaded). NULL on every non-settlement row, and on a settlement whose state neither source settles. Both copies can be present; prefer FALSE.

stlmt_cell_grain.description: The STLMT relations' schema: cell_grain plus three layout grammar columns (block_label, row_kind, column_code) that keep the real settlement layout explicit. Values are VARCHAR verbatim: a blank is the en dash U+2013, and a large number can arrive in E-notation ('5.0E7').

columns.name: row_num
columns.description: 1-based position of the source row as the sheet reader returned it.

columns.name: block_label
columns.description: Title of the block the row sits in, on a sheet stacked from title/header/data blocks (STLMT Table A2: the CMS-HCC block, then the demographic block); NULL elsewhere.

columns.name: group_label
columns.description: Nearest unbracketed section header above the row (the merged primary group).

columns.name: section_code
columns.description: Bracketed section code, e.g. 'A1' from '[A1] Person Years'; NULL for an unbracketed section.

columns.name: section_label
columns.description: Label of the section the row belongs to.

columns.name: row_label
columns.description: Normalised label from column A of the data row.

columns.name: row_kind
columns.description: What the source row is. 'CODE': the lettered row itself (its own cells are the figure, e.g. Table 3 '[A] Assigned Beneficiaries'; a lettered row left entirely blank still loads, its cells NULL). 'DETAIL': a row under a lettered or group heading (an enrollment type, a Table A1/A2 row, a Table A4 grid row, a Parameters key). 'TOTAL': an unlettered row repeating its section's label, which closes the section with its total (Table 2 [A]). A lettered row that only heads detail rows is not emitted.

columns.name: column_group_label
columns.description: Merged primary header above a two-level column header; NULL for single-level headers and always NULL on key/value (Parameters) sheets.

columns.name: column_code
columns.description: Letter closing the source header label, cut from column_label (Table A1: 'Final Risk Ratio (Capped) [I]' gives 'I'); NULL elsewhere.

columns.name: column_label
columns.description: Header label of the value column this cell came from, normalised, with any column_code removed. Table A4's column A (data, not a label) appears as its own column.

columns.name: value_text
columns.description: The cell value, VARCHAR verbatim ('-' stays '-').

BNMRK.cadence: Up to three deliveries per performance year (March preliminary, June, October), distinguished by submission_id.

AEXPU.cadence: One workbook per benchmark year (BY1/BY2/BY3), delivered inside the BNMRK bundle. The final settlement (STLMT) bundle also carries one, for the performance year; its submission_id starts 'STLMT.' and it is not part of any benchmark delivery.

STLMT.cadence: One workbook per performance year, in the final settlement bundle (around August to November of PY+1). CMS can deliver the bundle twice, embargoed and unembargoed, with the same workbook; both load as separate submissions, and a reader prefers is_embargoed = FALSE. Only files named '...STLMT.Y<year>.D<YYMMDD>.T<NNNNNNN>.xlsx' are read.

optional_sheet_behavior.summary: Not every delivery carries every sheet. An optional relation whose source sheet is absent from the deliveries in a batch contributes zero rows for that batch rather than raising; the relation and its full cell-grain schema still materialise. A relation is flagged 'optional' when its source sheet is legitimately absent from some conforming deliveries.
optional_sheet_behavior.absent_sheet: optional relation: zero rows, schema-conformant table still produced (not an error)
optional_sheet_behavior.missing_required_sheet: error: a workbook lacking the sheet of a relation not flagged 'optional' fails that relation, and so the run
optional_sheet_behavior.ambiguous_sheet_pattern: error (a pattern must select exactly one sheet per workbook)

optional_relations.BNMRK_TABLE_6: 'Table 6 - ACPT' is present only in the June and October deliveries, not the March preliminary.
optional_relations.AEXPU_TABLE_1A: COVID-excluding variant present in the BY1/BY2 workbooks and absent from BY3.
optional_relations.AEXPU_TABLE_4A: COVID-excluding variant present in the BY1/BY2 workbooks and absent from BY3.
optional_relations.STLMT_TABLE_A6: 'Table A6 - ACPT' is present only for agreements on the accountable care prospective trend, as BNMRK 'Table 6 - ACPT' is.
